title: Managed Database: vCore count
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database vCore count is specified by contracted tier. Provisioned cores per database node; integer. Memory GiB per database node; integer.

| Contracted tier | Vcore count | Memory in gib |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 2 | 8 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 4 | 16 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 8 | 32 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 16 | 64 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 32 | 128 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 64 | 256 |

## Hypothetical tier comparison
Hypothetical comparison limited to vCore count: choosing Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore instead of Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore changes this value from 2 to 64, a difference of 62. This comparison describes that parameter alone.
